key_drivers: Mechanical beat setup: S&P +14.5% in the June quarter, AUM pre-disclosed at $1.79T with $9B long-term net inflows, four straight quarters averaging a 19% EPS surprise
BEN lagged its own group into the print (-1.4% on the month vs peers +6.5%), so less of the sector re-rating is in this name
Against it: +40% YTD, 3.7% off the 52w high, average target $34.45 vs $33.17 spot - roughly 4% of upside left
Base rate a coin flip on sign (4 up, 4 down) but skewed in the tails: three prints above +6.8%, worst down only -4.4%
Peer read-through genuinely mixed - BNY beat and rose 4.1%, State Street beat and fell 2.2%
what_would_change_my_mind: Confirmation that fiscal-Q4 expense guidance was raised, or that the sequential decline in investment management fees is worse than the -2.4% consensus assumes.
